hooks.command: HOOK="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.crosslink/integrations/hooks/post-edit-check.py"; if [ -f "$HOOK" ]; then CROSSLINK_HOOK_PROVIDER=claude python3 "$HOOK"; else exit 0; fi
HOOK="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.crosslink/integrations/hooks/heartbeat.py"; if [ -f "$HOOK" ]; then CROSSLINK_HOOK_PROVIDER=claude python3 "$HOOK"; else exit 0; fi
HOOK="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.crosslink/integrations/hooks/work-check.py"; if [ -f "$HOOK" ]; then CROSSLINK_HOOK_PROVIDER=claude python3 "$HOOK"; else exit 0; fi
HOOK="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.crosslink/integrations/hooks/session-start.py"; if [ -f "$HOOK" ]; then CROSSLINK_HOOK_PROVIDER=claude python3 "$HOOK"; else exit 0; fi

hooks._note: crosslink init re-activates rules-injecting UserPromptSubmit/SubagentStart hooks from its generated integrations. Those hooks read managed Markdown rule inputs and emit them as prompt context, which is the filesystem rule injector S-007 removed; tests/legacy_rule_injector_removed_e2e.rs enforces its absence. Those two hook entries were removed here. Re-running crosslink init restores them; remove them again.
